title: Dune Garden
subtitle: 海与沙之间的庭院
description: A coastal garden that works with the wind. Low stone walls, a shallow reflecting pool and bands of dune grass frame a timber pavilion, holding a quiet courtyard between the house and the sea.
descriptionZh: 一座顺应海风的庭院。低矮石墙、浅水镜面与成带的沙草围合出木构凉亭，在住宅与海之间留下一处安静的院落。
